update_policy: OpenCode resolves at image build according to the selected latest|safe policy; the resolved CLI/plugin/SDK versions are recorded inside the immutable image. Other critical runtime defaults remain reviewed here.

opencode_cli.compatibility_note: Fresh Awoki OpenCode image builds resolve the current npm latest unless safe mode supplies an exact version. The resolved version is recorded in /usr/local/share/awoki/opencode-runtime.json. Auto-update remains disabled inside a running container. The runtime compatibility gate also requires the resolved CLI to expose the reviewed web/attach authentication surfaces used by Awoki shared-backend mode.

opencode_plugin_api.compatibility_note: The image build materializes this package at the exact OpenCode CLI version resolved for that image and runs the runtime compatibility gate.

opencode_sdk_api.compatibility_note: The image build installs the SDK at the exact resolved OpenCode CLI version and verifies the three package versions agree.

lavish_axi.compatibility_note: Lavish review launches through npx with this exact default. AWOKI_LAVISH_VERSION may be explicitly overridden for testing, but release validation tracks this default.

system_package_policy: The Dockerfiles are authoritative for direct Debian package names. Exact Debian package versions and pip bootstrap tooling are inherited from the recorded base-image lines rather than silently treated as Awoki API compatibility pins.
